concept: Spotting misinformation and understanding why false claims can spread so easily
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student is shown a realistic, plausible-sounding piece of misinformation (low-stakes topic) circulating online
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides how to verify it before deciding whether to believe or share it
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what made the false claim believable in the first place

assessment.success_marker: student identifies a specific reason the claim was persuasive (emotional appeal, false authority, etc.) beyond 'it seemed true'
